mcp_tools.name: agent_interoperability_design
mcp_tools.title: Agent interoperability design
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared agent-interoperability design manifest; get a deterministic DESIGN_SOUND / DESIGN_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections (protocol selection, bridge architecture, gateway and remote access, handoff contracts, identity and credentials, versioning and discovery, audit and provenance, handshake testing and red lines) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The agent-interoperability design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All boolean requirements met; protocol match valid; red lines respected. Computed spot checks: integration_count=1, protocol_status=sound_on_declared_evidence.
